result.description:
Delivery Manager- Power Distribution     Location:   Melbourne (SE Melbourne Depot)     Randstad is looking for a talented  Delivery Manager- Power Distribution    for a well known contractor. This role will be based in the South Eastern Suburbs and will manage a field delivery team as well as a major contract/program. We're looking for a confident, collaborative, and values-driven  Delivery Manager- Power Distribution  to lead a diverse portfolio of power distribution projects- ops & maintenance, emergency response, new connections, etc. If you're someone who thrives in a site environment, excels at managing trades/high performing teams and juggling priorities, I want to hear from you!      
  Key Responsibilities:  
  As a  Delivery Manager- Power Distribution      you will:  
 
  Manage project budgets, timelines  
 Build long lasting relationships with clients and stakeholders 
 Prioritise safety and HSE standards 
 Manage day to day field operations 
 Manage linesworkers and trades  
 Promote a safety focused atmosphere as well as champion a collaborative, efficient, and high performing culture 
 
  Experience:  
 
 Certificate III or higher in electrical utilities, power systems, or project management 
 Background in managing field teams, working with unions, conducting toolbox meetings, etc. 
 A thoughtful, inclusive approach to risk, stakeholder engagement, and vendor relationships. 
 Solid technical knowledge of engineering or construction, grounded in best practice and ethical leadership. 
 A natural mentor - you're someone who shares knowledge generously and helps others grow. 
 Comfortable using Microsoft suite of applications (outlook, excel, project) tools like SAP, and confident navigating the commercial and contractual landscape. Power BI understanding a plus! 
 A current Australian Driver's Licence and an understanding of key legislative frameworks impacting utility work. 
 Proven ability delivering distribution or utility projects before - but most important is your ability to lead with clarity, compassion, and competence. 
 
  What's In It For You:  
 
  Long term stability with a strong pipeline of exciting projects  
 A well-known contractor with a strong name in the market 
 Work with the local DNSPs and distribution projects in and around Melbourne 
 
To apply to this  Delivery Manager- Power Distribution    role: click apply or send a CV to danielle.jacobson@randstad.com.au

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.
